title: reaction.autoignited
description: M15D § fires for an `auto_ignite: true` reaction the moment its `min_temperature_k` threshold is first crossed (or pressure threshold for PV-gated entries). Distinct from `triggered` because autoignition events are interesting for AI hazard avoidance + cinematic banner triggers + cfctl alerts. Carries the reaction id, position, ambient temperature at ignition, and the locked spec ΔH per acceptance scenario 4 ('delta_h_kj = -483.6 * moles_reacted').
